"""Record actual terminal states after every owned primary stage completes."""

import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V153-delivered-objective-v1')
training = read(root / 'status-v1.json')
post = read(root / 'postprocess-status-v2.json')
assert training['status'] == 'completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review'
assert post['status'] == 'completed-audited-paired-arrays-awaiting-human-native-viewing'
assert set(post['completed']) == {'review', 'training-audit', 'scores', 'metric-audit', 'render'}
owners = [('training-controller', training['owner'])]
owners += [(name, read(root / f'{name}-result-v1.json')['owner'])
           for name in ['parity', 'smoke', 'train']]
owners += [('postprocess-controller', post['owner'])]
owners += [(stage, binding['owner']) for stage, binding in post['completed'].items()]
failed = read(root / 'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert failed['status'] == 'failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry'
owners += [('failed-preclaim-review-controller', failed['owner'])]
owners += [('reused-v1-training-state-audit', failed['completed']['training-state-audit']['owner'])]
assert len(owners) == 12
records = []
for stage, owner in owners:
    try:
        process = psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
        if abs(process.create_time() - owner['created']) >= .01:
            status = 'PID-reused-original-owner-terminal'
        else:
            status = process.status()
            assert status in ['zombie', 'dead'], (stage, owner, status)
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        status = 'absent'
    records.append({'stage': stage, 'owner': owner, 'terminal_state': status})
excluded = {os.getpid()} | {p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()}
matching = []
for process in psutil.process_iter(['pid', 'cmdline', 'status']):
    if process.pid in excluded or process.info['status'] in ['zombie', 'dead']:
        continue
    tokens = process.info['cmdline'] or []
    if any(t == str(root) or t.startswith(str(root) + '/')
           or t == str(root.relative_to(root.parents[2])) for t in tokens):
        matching.append(process.info)
assert not matching, matching
save(root / 'execution-completion-v1.json', {
    'status': 'all12-recorded-owners-terminal-plus-unretained-failed-child', 'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(),
    'recorded_owner_count': 12, 'failed_preclaim_reviewer_count': 1, 'unretained_failed_child_owner_count': 1, 'owners': records, 'live_matching_root_argv': matching,
    'training_completion': ref(root / 'status-v1.json'),
    'postprocess_completion': ref(root / 'postprocess-status-v2.json'),
    'verifier': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'preclaim_failure': ref(root / 'postprocess-preclaim-failure-v1.json'),
    'scope': 'Exact PID/create-time terminal checks for12 retained owners:training controller/3 phases,failed v1 postprocess controller/its state-audit worker,and corrected v2 controller/5 postprocess workers. One additional failed reviewer child owner was not retained when v1 overwrote transient status; its nonzero return and preclaim traceback are preserved,so its exact PID/create-time is not claimed. No endpoint arrays or CUDA/head calls before that failure; first endpoint collection runs only under v2. Training was not restarted.'})
print('PASS: all12 retained owners terminal; failed preclaim child PID unretained; no live root argv matches')
